AI Agents have become increasingly prevalent in our daily lives, especially in the realm of conversational interactions. These intelligent systems are designed to engage in natural language processing (NLP) tasks, helping users navigate websites, provide information, and perform various actions based on user queries or commands.

What exactly is an AI Agent? At its core, an AI Agent is a system that can interpret human language, understand context, and perform tasks on behalf affects its users. This definition encompasses a wide range of capabilities that make AI Agents versatile and impactful in modern technology.

Structure

AI Agents typically have a layered structure to handle different aspects of interacting with the world. The main components of an AI Agent are:

1. Language Understanding: This part parses user inputs and understands the user's intent and requirements.
